title: Hedley Byrne & Co Ltd v Heller & Partners Ltd

content.caseIdentity: Hedley Byrne & Co Ltd v Heller & Partners Ltd, [1964] AC 465
content.facts: Deceit requires fraudulent knowledge or recklessness; negligent misstatement turns on duty, reasonable reliance and breach.
questionsBeforeCourt: What legal rule governs the doctrine?
content.ratioDecidendi: Deceit requires fraudulent knowledge or recklessness; negligent misstatement turns on duty, reasonable reliance and breach.
content.holding: Deceit requires fraudulent knowledge or recklessness; negligent misstatement turns on duty, reasonable reliance and breach.
